item.title: Southwind Guardian Portal Build
item.description:
1500-3000 USD | Full-Stack Developer or Development Team for Southwind Guardian Client Portal
I own Southwind Marketing, a marketing and communications company serving businesses, local governments and community organizations. I am looking for an experienced developer or small development team to build Southwind Guardian into a working client and staff platform.
Guardian currently exists as a service: clients send website content updates and support requests through their account manager. We want to expand that service with a branded portal where clients can manage permitted website content, request assistance, collaborate on projects, approve work, access reports and manage social content.
The platform must also serve clients who do not purchase our website services. Someone hiring us for a website build, Civic Intelligence survey, site-selector marketing campaign or consulting project should be able to use Guardian for communication, files, milestones and approvals.
We have a detailed scope, visual references and an AI-assisted Next.js/TypeScript/PostgreSQL/Supabase codebase. This is not a finished production application. You may reuse suitable code or recommend a rebuild with a clear explanation.
I am looking for someone with demonstrated experience in full-stack application development, WordPress/Elementor integrations, secure client portals, granular permissions, approval workflows and API integrations. You should be comfortable owning the technical implementation, testing and deployment.
The required platform includes:
1. WordPress website editing
Connect our WordPress websites, currently hosted on Cloudways, to Guardian. Most use Elementor.
Clients must be able to edit permitted text, images, links, documents, posts and approved page sections through Guardian. Include drafts, previews, approval requests, publishing results and version recovery. Authorized users can publish directly; other users submit changes for approval. Clients must also be able to request that Southwind staff make changes for them.
Validate compatibility against our actual sites and identify supported templates, widgets, fields and actions. The solution must protect the website’s layout and handle conflicting changes safely. Simply providing a link to unrestricted WordPress administration will not satisfy this requirement.
2. Client portal
Provide a branded home screen showing the client’s account manager, active services, projects, deadlines, outstanding requests and approvals.
Clients should be able to communicate with staff, submit requests, upload assets, review deliverables, download reports and track progress. Display only the services and actions available to that client. The portal must work for clients without a connected website, Google account or Southwind Connect account.
3. Staff and contractor workspace
Include management of clients, projects, milestones, tasks, tickets, recurring work, assignments, files and discussions.
Staff must be able to assign work to themselves, other authorized staff or contractors and complete work themselves. Include work queues, overdue items, workload, onboarding progress, pending approvals, failed notifications and connection status.
Contractors must see only explicitly assigned work, necessary files and designated discussions. Internal staff notes and administration must remain private.
4. Onboarding, intake and offboarding
Include editable service-specific intake forms, asset collection, reusable project templates, recurring checklists, invitations, first-login guidance and reminders.
Clients should be able to save and resume intake forms. Staff should be able to request corrections and track completion.
Include service changes and offboarding with work transfer, permitted exports and access removal. For connected GoHighLevel accounts, include opportunity-Won onboarding with safeguards against duplicate clients, projects and invitations.
5. Files, reports and approvals
Staff must be able to organize, update and share PDFs and supporting files against the correct client and project. Clients can access shared reports; internal files remain private.
Approvals must apply to a specific version of a deliverable. Include comments, requested changes, decision history, due dates, reminders and authorized reassignment. An overdue approval must never automatically approve itself.
Include a searchable client help area that staff can maintain.
6. Social management and reporting
Clients and staff should be able to create content, review and approve it, schedule publication and view publishing results in a calendar.
Include analytics, downloadable reports and agreed reputation workflows, such as viewing and replying to reviews. Verify the supported networks, post formats, metrics and account requirements before committing.
Assess existing Southwind Connect/GoHighLevel connections first. Clearly identify any additional provider subscriptions, applications or approvals required.
7. Permissions, branding and security
Support agency administrators, ordinary staff, contractors and client users with different viewing, editing, approval and publishing permissions.
Use database-level row security and server authorization to isolate agency, client, project and assigned-work data. Include privileged-user MFA, private file access, audit history and hosted isolation/revocation testing using a second test agency.
Southwind is the only live agency initially. Keep Southwind branding separate from each client’s identity. Include branded invitations, welcome and recovery emails and responsive screens based on our approved designs.
8. Website and launch records
Include a staff register for websites, domains, hosting, technical contacts, connection status and renewal responsibility.
Support staging review, client launch approval, launch checklists and verification records. Existing domain and hosting ownership must remain under our control.
The following should be quoted as separate options:
- Google and Facebook sign-in for convenience; ordinary email login is required. - Selection and sharing of existing Google Drive documents. - Viewing and replying to existing Connect SMS/email conversations inside Guardian. Our Twilio service runs through GoHighLevel; existing numbers and routing must be preserved. - Cloudflare status synchronization or authorized infrastructure controls.
Delivery expectations:
Technical review should be included in development, not sold as a separate assessment. Develop and deploy in accounts we control, with source code committed to our repository throughout the project.
Include testing, backups and restore verification, documentation, staff training, handover and 90 days of post-launch defect support. Ongoing maintenance should be optional and quoted separately.
Please include in your proposal:
- Relevant working examples and what you personally implemented. - Your approach to Elementor editing and approval workflows. - What you would reuse, refactor or rebuild. - A fixed total for the required scope, with milestone deliverables and separately priced options. - A realistic schedule with demonstrations, testing and launch. - Recurring costs, dependencies, compatibility limits and exclusions. - Who will perform development, design, testing and support.
The attached SOW defines the detailed requirements and acceptance checks. Please quote against the complete required release and identify any proposed changes before agreement.

item.title: Earn First $1K: Shopify Emails

item.title: Power Platform Enterprise HR Portal
item.description:
25-50 USD/hr | I need an experienced Microsoft Power Platform professional to architect and build a web-based HR portal with Power Pages at its core. The first release must handle HR and applicant tracking, onboarding with employee self-service, plus PTO and benefits management, all surfaced through clean, role-based pages for HR managers, supervisors, and employees.
The new site has to live comfortably inside our Microsoft 365 environment and connect, through standard or custom connectors, to three critical back-end systems—our ERP, payroll solution, and existing document-management repository—so data flows bidirectionally without manual touch points. Think of the experience as a light-weight alternative to Arcoro, but fully aligned with our internal processes and security model.
Scope highlights • Design the overall information architecture, Dataverse schema, and security roles that map to HR managers, supervisors, and employee self-service. • Build Power Pages sites for candidate application, onboarding tasks, time-off requests, and benefit elections, complete with approval workflows in Power Automate. • Surface documents stored in our DMS, trigger e-signatures where required, and write key events back to ERP and payroll. • Provide responsive layout and accessible design so staff can work comfortably on desktop and mobile browsers.
Acceptance A successful milestone demonstrates end-to-end creation of a position, posting to the external page, candidate submission, HR review, conversion to employee, and a completed PTO request that posts to payroll.
If you have deep Power Pages and Dataverse experience and have integrated ERP or payroll systems before, I’m ready to discuss timelines, milestones, and any additional technical details you need.

Customers will be able to submit a service request, schedule an appointment, make payment, and track the status of their order. The platform will also require an admin dashboard to manage customers, providers, jobs, payments, assignments, documents, and exceptions.

Clean, modern, extremely easy-to-use website
Mobile-first responsive design
Customer booking and checkout system
Secure customer and provider accounts
Provider onboarding/verification
Available-job marketplace
Real-time job acceptance/assignment
SMS and email notifications
Payment processing and provider payouts
Document/report upload
Admin dashboard
Secure database and user authentication
Architecture capable of expanding nationwide
Strong focus on reliability, speed, and simple user experience

Ownership is non-negotiable: all source code, GitHub repositories, hosting/cloud accounts, databases, domain accounts, payment accounts, APIs, credentials, and other project assets must remain under my/company control. The completed platform must be transferable to another developer without dependency on the original developer.
I already have a more detailed development SOP available for qualified candidates.
When applying, please include examples of marketplace, booking, dispatch, payment, or similar platforms you have built, your recommended technology stack, estimated development timeline, fixed-price or milestone-based cost, and who will actually be performing the development work.

item.title: Redesign ABLE Authority Website
item.description:
250-750 AUD | THE ABLE AUTHORITY — WEBSITE REPOSITIONING & REDESIGN
Our current website is: https://www.ableauthority.com.au
Project Overview We are repositioning and significantly redesigning: The ABLE Authority
The ABLE Authority develops experts, authors, professionals, entrepreneurs and emerging leaders into recognised authorities in their fields.
Our new customer-facing positioning will centre around four simple, aspirational pillars:
PUBLISH → LAUNCH → SPEAK → TRANSFORM
Leading ultimately to: BECOME THE OBVIOUS CHOICE
We require an experienced Wix/Wix Studio designer with strong UX/UI, brand and conversion experience to restructure and redesign the existing website around this new proposition.
The Strategic Change
The current website leads heavily with concepts such as the Authority Gap Assessment and Authority Reality Audit. These are valuable proprietary tools, but we no longer want them to be the primary way people first understand The ABLE Authority.
The new website should lead with what our audience wants to achieve, rather than requiring them to first understand a diagnostic methodology.
The primary journey becomes:
PUBLISH Turn expertise, knowledge and ideas into a professionally published book and intellectual property.
LAUNCH Bring the book, ideas and personal authority into the marketplace through professional launches, events and platforms.
SPEAK Take the message beyond the book through stages, presentations, keynotes, media and other speaking opportunities.
TRANSFORM We help you Use the knowledge, message and authority to positively influence people, organisations, industries and communities.
All four ultimately contribute to: BECOMING THE OBVIOUS CHOICE.
Important Brand Positioning We do not want the website to make The ABLE Authority look like simply a: publishing company + book launch company + speaking company.
The four pillars are mechanisms for developing authority.
The website must communicate that ABLE provides an integrated ecosystem through which someone's:
Expertise → becomes Intellectual Property → becomes a Platform → creates Influence → enables Transformation. This distinction is critical to the project.
What Happens to Our Existing IP?
Existing proprietary concepts such as: The Authority Gap Five Authority Gaps Authority Reality Audit Law of Human Gravity Authority Journey are not necessarily being removed.
However, they should become supporting methodology and diagnostic tools deeper within the customer journey, rather than dominating the homepage proposition.
The freelancer should therefore simplify the front-end message without diluting or discarding the intellectual depth behind the brand.
Website Experience The redesigned website should feel: Premium • Authoritative • Aspirational • Sophisticated • Modern • Minimal • Human
Number of pages: at least 4 pages ( not a single landing page)
We want significantly: Less dynamic and more effective - Less unnecessary animation - More white space - Stronger typography and visual hierarchy - Clearer navigation - Strong visual storytelling - Stronger CTAs - Clear pathways into Publish, Launch, Speak and Transform - Excellent mobile/tablet responsiveness - Fast performance and SEO fundamentals
The website should not resemble a generic coaching, motivational-speaking or publishing website. Within approximately 10 seconds, a visitor should understand: What ABLE Authority is → What it can help them achieve → Why it is different → Where they should go next.
Homepage Direction We envisage the homepage establishing the proposition very quickly: PUBLISH. LAUNCH. SPEAK. TRANSFORM. Turn your expertise into a book. Your book into a platform. Your platform into influence. Your influence into transformation. BECOME THE OBVIOUS CHOICE. The designer will have creative freedom to propose a better UX/UI interpretation of this concept. We do not want someone simply following instructions—we value strategic design recommendations where they improve the customer experience.
Required Skills:
Applicants should demonstrate strong experience in: Wix / Wix Studio Premium UX/UI design Website conversion strategy Brand positioning and storytelling Professional-service websites Responsive/mobile design Website performance and SEO fundamentals

item.title: WordPress/PHP Expert Needed – Fix Changes Reverting, REST/API & Admin Issues
item.description:
36+ GBP/hr | I’m battling an aggravating situation on my WordPress/Divi site: changes I make in the builder, plugin updates and some dashboard settings appear to save and then quietly roll back. Activating or deactivating plugins can also fail.
The live website is also reporting an error, and I have had an issue with the cookie banner disappearing, so I would like the overall WordPress installation checked rather than treating this as only a Divi problem.
SiteGround has investigated and found application-level 403 responses involving Divi and Jetpack. ModSecurity was checked and was not identified as the cause, and Cloudflare Development Mode made no difference.
What you’ll encounter Divi changes that don’t persist Plugin updates and settings that revert Plugin activation/deactivation failures, sometimes returning “The link you followed has expired” REST/API-related 403 responses An error reported on the live website Cookie banner/functionality issues Several caching layers: Cloudflare, SiteGround Optimiser and Divi CSS caching
A useful controlled test on staging: I added TEST124 in Divi. The Divi sync-to-server request returned 200 OK, contained TEST124 in the payload, and returned save_verification: true. After reloading, TEST124 had disappeared.
Scope of work Replicate the problems and identify the underlying cause, including database, filesystem, permissions, REST/API, authentication/nonces and caching. Audit all installed plugins for duplicates, obsolete or unnecessary plugins and conflicts. Nothing should be removed until the site is stable. Review WordPress, Divi, Wordfence, Jetpack, SiteGround Optimiser, Cloudflare and REST/security settings.
